emails.subject: You’re part of our first chapter
emails.preview: Welcome to Louie Mae. We’re so glad you’re here.
emails.heading: A little welcome, with love.
paragraphs: Thank you for joining the Louie Mae waitlist. You’re part of the beginning of something close to our hearts.
Rooted in faith and gathered around family, Louie Mae brings together furniture and home accents, clothing for you, and thoughtful finds for your little ones.
Over the next few days, we’ll share a little of our story and a first look at what’s coming. When our doors open, you’ll hear from us here.

emails.subject: The heart behind Louie Mae
emails.preview: Rooted in faith. Gathered around family.
emails.heading: For the life you’re building.
paragraphs: A home holds so much more than the things inside it. It holds the conversations around the table, the everyday routines, and the people we love.
Louie Mae began with a love for that kind of life. Faith, family, and the beauty of ordinary moments are at the heart of the collection we’re gathering.
We’re drawn to earthy colors, inviting textures, and pieces that feel at ease in everyday life. Thank you for being here as our next chapter takes shape.

emails.subject: A little glimpse of what’s coming
emails.preview: For your home, your wardrobe, and your little ones.
emails.heading: Thoughtfully gathered.
paragraphs: We’re bringing three parts of Louie Mae together, each with its own place in the life you’re building.
Home — furniture and accents for spaces that feel welcoming and beautifully lived in.
The Mae Collective — clothing with easy silhouettes and romantic details.
Louie Kids & Co. — thoughtful finds for little everyday wonders.
You can explore a preview on our website while we get ready to welcome you.

emails.subject: What are you looking forward to?
emails.preview: We’d love to hear what caught your eye.
emails.heading: There’s a place for you here.
paragraphs: Now that you’ve had a glimpse of Louie Mae, we’d love to know what you’re most excited to discover.
Something for your home? A new piece for your wardrobe? A little find for someone small? Just reply to this email and tell us.
We’ll be in touch with more news as opening day gets closer. Until then, thank you for being part of our first chapter.
